t: ff.94 Is fat bad for you?

sec.p: In past issues we talked about obesity (🎼 ff.49 The pandemic of the 21st century). It's a delicate, tangled subject, just like the rest of human biology.

sec.t: ff.94.2 Good fats and bad fats
sec.p: A bit of fat is good for you. But which kind?
OK, I've thrown more meat on the fire and the question “which fats?” is even more tangled.
